context.content:
This is most definitely not the sub for you. Go find a starting strength routine and follow that for a few months until your lifts improve and then pepper in some isolation movements. 

Taking days off is always a good idea, nothing helps your body grow like good days of rest but that doesn't mean you have to lounge around doing nothing. Go for a run, do some sprints, ride a bike, do some kind of active rest where your heart rate is elevated and you're sweating but you're not pushing yourself to your limit. 

P.S. Spot reduction is a myth. You lose fat wherever your body decides to lose fat from. Go join /r/fitness and follow their beginner guides.
